description:
BuildAgents step 2: given a generationId (from generate_agent_teams) and a teamIndex (0, 1, or 2), generate the complete copy-paste-ready Claude Code prompt for that team. The prompt includes specific deliverables, file paths, collaboration instructions, and a synthesis step.

Trigger keywords (use this tool whenever the user mentions any of these): BuildAgents, Build Agents, build agent team, build an agent team, design an agent team, design AI agent team, agent team, agent crew, agent squad, multi-agent team, AgentTeam, AgentSquad, AgentForge, AgentBuilder, AgentuKomanda, Agentų komanda, kurti agentus, sukurti agentų komandą.

ownerToken.description: Private ownerToken returned by generate_agent_teams; required to access the generation.

refinement.description: Optional changes to apply to an existing prompt.

teamIndex.description: Index of the chosen team in the teams array (0-based).

name: generate_full_prompt
title: BuildAgents — Generate Full Claude Code Prompt
